full_name: Ellen More | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Ellen More’s work covers the history of women in American medicine from 1850 to the present, the conceptualization and history of empathy in the doctor-patient relationship, and more recently the controversy over sex education programs.
